Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE COMPLETE 1600x1100 landscape Chinese desktop UI for MovieAgent, local single-user Windows filmmaking application. Current date 2026-11-03. Flat edge-to-edge screen, no device/browser frames, no collage. User specifically REJECTED yellowish/beige/cream UI backgrounds. This is a hard requirement:
EVERY UI BACKGROUND MUST BE NEUTRAL PURE WHITE #FFFFFF or neutral pale gray #F5F6F8. No beige, no ivory, no cream, no warm off-white, NO PAPER TEXTURE, NO yellow tint, no sepia, no grain on the app surfaces. Neutral dark media-editor surfaces can be #111214. Pure WHITE means visually white, RGB channels balanced, not parchment. Photographic content can have its natural colors. The white background in the supplied navigation website is the color reference; LibTV image is a reference for neutral black/gray, not a request to copy its sidebar. Do not imitate warm backgrounds inside moodboard thumbnails.
Design language: a confident contemporary cinema studio, asset-led and editorial, precise optical typography, large strong film imagery and quiet whitespace, refined floating navigation. A radical complete redesign rather than a recolor of a generic dashboard. Purewhite base, neutralgray partitions, ink#121316 text, cobalt#2D61E8 selectively for primary buttons/current item, very small orange warning marks. Use clean Chinese sans-serif for normal interface; restrained editorial serif only in a large one-line catalogue headline. No old-fashioned book/paper aesthetic. No random 3D robots, glowing orbs, mesh gradients, green glow, glass everywhere, repeated bento cards, cards-within-cards, or enormous sidebar.
Shared workspace shell: left wordmark "movieagent" and simple cobalt aperture; top CENTER floating white capsule 5 labels "项目 创作 制作 素材 成片", soft short neutral shadow, active cobalt capsule withwhite text. Top right searchicon, "任务2", settingsgear. No fixed vertical global sidebar. Below topnav thin projectcontext line "雨夜来信 / 第02集" with scopedropdowns and LOCAL page tabs. The result should feel fresh and functional, not a marketing landing page. 15-16px readable Chinese body font, compact aligned formcontrols, large imageryonlywhereitservesworkflow, clean1px dividers, 10-14px mediacorners, pillshapesonlynav/buttons. Important: do not add promotional slogans on dense editing screens.
Project fictional imagery: Rainy harbor oldtown, gray-blue sea, redlighthouse, original EastAsian woman LinWan with blackshoulderlengthhair, whiteblouse and navyovercoat, holdingcream envelope. Attractive filmphotography, real natural skin, no generic smilingstockfaces. Consistent character across all filmstills. Optional secondaryprojects a desertbus and bluecoast. These are creative storyassets, notUIbackgrounds.
Reference roles: usermoodboard=boldimagery/hierarchy, website navbar=neutralwhite/navigation, LibTV=neutraltones, generatedreference ifsupplied=sharedbrandandshell. Adapt composition to currentworkflow, do notcopy coverart into everysettingspage.
Keep functionalreality: no cloud/team/revenueanalytics; Agentproposals requireselection/adoption; External-agent functionality is picture import/reuse only, no automatic film edit/export; fourtimelinetracksonly; fixedversionsandapprovals areexplicit. Smallbottom "概念设计 · 示例内容". Pagebrief:
 Do not print technical implementation phases or identifiers such as M1/M2/M3 anywhere in product UI. Global context row must NOT contain approval-state or application-version selectors. Plain concise Chinese task labels, no extra controls not requested below.

edits.15: Edit ONLY the small explanatory text at the bottom right of this complete MovieAgent task-center UI screenshot. Replace the two explanatory lines under the task action buttons with these precise accurate Chinese lines: 恢复说明：先核实原任务，再收存已有结果。 and 取消说明：取消请求会登记；已保存资料仍保留。 These lines must be readable and must NOT say cancellation deletes generated results or that recovery replaces outputs.
